title: New Reactome Paper published
body:
##  New Reactome Paper published 

A new Reactome paper titled “Reactome pathway analysis: a high-performance in-memory approach” has been published in [BMC Bioinformatics](<https://bmcbioinformatics.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12859-017-1559-2>). More publications from the [Reactome Team](</about/team>) can be found [here](</community/publications>).
